title: Design-only stub: S3 Vectors store adapter
description:
## Purpose

Record a design-only stub for an Amazon S3 Vectors `VectorStore` adapter behind the same interface, so it can be built later without changing callers.

## Scope (design only; not built in this phase)

- One vector bucket and one index per pool revision; `dataType float32`, `distanceMetric cosine`; filterable metadata `label`, `pool_revision`, `input_hash`.
- `PutVectors` in batches of ≤500; `QueryVectors(topK=k+1, filter={"label": L})`, then target exclusion client-side; design for 100 results per page.
- IAM `s3vectors:*`; filters/metadata also need `s3vectors:GetVectors`. `boto3.client('s3vectors')`, minimum boto3 version not found.
- Risks: approximate search (fingerprint records `approximate: true`), eventual consistency after writes (can break exact replay), account setup. At ~5k vectors in-memory search is strictly better.
- **AWS facts checked on 2026-10-01** against official pages (design Appendix B): GA 2025-12-02; 31 Regions after 2026-03-31; limits and API as listed. Pricing came from a summarizing fetch, and `CreateVectorBucket` / GovCloud are UNVERIFIED: **re-check before building.**

## Definition of done

The adapter design (mapping of `upsert`/`query` onto the API, config keys under `store.kind: s3vectors`, IAM list, risks, items to re-verify) is recorded in core docs or on this issue; no boto3 dependency, no AWS calls, no code path enabled. Cost: $0.

## Design

[DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md) §4.1, §4.5, Appendix B (Amazon S3 Vectors).

## Companion-project coordination

- [Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/tree/main/project/issues): `decision-flywheel-evaluations-f06dcf08-6182-41ce-a9f5-31b37d08bf51`.

These are cross-repository references; local Kanbus blocked-by relationships encode prerequisites within this repository.

Implemented on branch `phase3-retrieval` (worktree Decision-Flywheel-phase3), commits 0b15981 and fed787d; not merged or pushed. Offline only: specs use fake embedders, no network. `make test` equivalent: 289 passed (226 existing + 63 new).

`vector_stores.S3VectorsStore(vector_bucket, index_name, region)`: design-only stub; `approximate = True`; configuration kind `s3vectors`; `upsert`/`query` raise NotImplementedError. Docstring records the API mapping from Appendix B (CreateIndex float32/cosine, PutVectors <=500, QueryVectors topK=k+1 with label filter, 100 per page, distance-to-similarity conversion, IAM incl. GetVectors) and the unverified items. Selectable as `store: {kind: s3vectors, ...}` with the embedding backend only. No boto3 dependency, no AWS calls. Specs check the VectorStore contract and the errors.
